body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Technocel, a leading accessory solution provider with over 11,000 products for the wireless market, announces the T360 Bluetooth Headset, an entry-level headset featuring Bluetooth version 2.1 technology for cell phone users. The T360 will be available starting January 30th, 2010 for MSRP of $39.99 at www.technocel.com

"We are providing a powerful hands-free headset option for frequent talkers on the go," says Rami Rostami, Technocel CEO and Founder. "We have designed the T360 to be a comfortable solution for first time users of Bluetooth technology."

Small and lightweight in size, the T360 is elegantly constructed with a black high-gloss finish. It is power packed with 5 hours of talk time and 150 hours of standby time, and is packaged with ear gels of multiple sizes for a comfortable perfect fit. Featuring call waiting, answer, reject and end functions, the T360 is a good option for Bluetooth users. The experience for first time Bluetooth users is also enhanced with Technocel's free technical support line.
For more information on product specifications as well as pricing and availability please visit www.technocel.com
